ArchitectureNotes.objective: Port Mark Text off abandoned Electron 18 + Vue 2 stack onto (A) modern Electron 30 + Vue 3 as intermediate v1.0, then (B) Tauri v2 + Rust as final v2.0, while merging 13 community PRs and delivering a Homebrew-installable, ad-hoc-signed macOS app.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Do NOT rewrite muya. It has zero Electron coupling (verified by grep) and ports to WebView unchanged.
Do NOT engage with upstream marktext/marktext maintainers. This is an independent fork.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: PR #4001 (electron-vite refactor) conflicts with bugfix PRs — resolved by merge-order: bugfixes first, then #4001.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: muya in WKWebView may be slower than Chromium on large docs — benchmark gate at Phase-B1.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: All 6 native modules (keytar, chokidar, fontmanager-redux, native-keymap, vscode-ripgrep, @hfelix/electron-localshortcut) must be replaced in Phase B.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-4: electron-store → tauri-plugin-store schema migration is one-way and must preserve user prefs.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-5: NSSpellChecker has no existing Tauri plugin; custom objc2 FFI required for Phase-B3.
ArchitectureNotes.strategy: Hybrid two-phase: Phase A ships value quickly (bugfixes + Vue 3 + slim build) as v1.0; Phase B is the radical Tauri port as v2.0. Between phases, ~2 weeks user-stabilization window.

contract.purpose: WYSIWYG Markdown engine: parses, renders, and edits Markdown in-place in DOM. Zero Electron coupling confirmed via triple-check grep. Ports to WebView as-is. 47 public methods + 26 events + 13 state invariants + 5 diagram renderers (Mermaid/Vega-Lite/Flowchart/Sequence/PlantUML) + 11 parser option flags + 19 inline + 16 block token types.

notes.note-1: DO NOT REWRITE. Only touch for bugfix PRs (#4135 empty-heading-slug) and renderer upgrades (#4025 Mermaid v11).
notes.note-2: **13 state invariants** must hold after every mutation: (a) non-empty root; (b) every block has unique key; (c) parent ↔ child pointers consistent; (d) list uniform marker; (e) table figure→table→thead+tbody→tr→th/td→span(cellContent); (f) heading no soft-breaks in atxLine; (g) one front-matter max and first block only; (h) code pre→code→span(codeContent) with lang synced to languageInput; (i) every span has .text .key .functionType; (j) no languageInput siblings in list; (k) task-item has [checkbox + p] children; (l) offset ≤ text.length; (m) no orphan blocks after removal.
notes.note-3: **Known upstream bugs to preserve as regressions (do NOT silently fix during port)**: (a) `exportMarkdown.js:300` pipe-escape misses cell-start; (b) `exportMarkdown.js:303-306` irregular table produces "undefined" literal; (c) `paragraphCtrl.js:116` nested list items without listType; (d) `enterCtrl.js:18` chopBlockByCursor O(n²) perf; (e) `deleteCtrl.js:27` empty-table delete crash (#67). Track each as separate bugfix PR after v1.0.
notes.note-4: **CJK/IME safety** — upstream has NO compositionstart lock in 6 keystroke handlers (R-27). Phase-A1.5 step must add composition flag in ContentState and gate keystroke handlers on `!isComposing`.
notes.note-5: **Parser security footguns** (R-32, R-33, R-34): (a) `partialRender` uses insertAdjacentHTML; (b) reference-def hrefs not sanitized at parse; (c) no recursion limit on blockquote/list/footnote. Port preserves behavior; V-M-010 fixture-xss payloads 23-27 below test mitigation.
notes.note-6: **Parser option flags** — 11 total: gfm, breaks, pedantic, footnote, frontMatter, math, superSubScript, emoji, isGitlabCompatibilityEnabled, disableHtml, smartLists. Contract snapshot test verifies all accepted and behave per plan.

Phase-A1-5.goal: Move Node core imports and @electron/remote usage out of renderer into main process + IPC handlers, so PR #4001's Vue 3 migration lands on a clean architecture.
Phase-A1-5.rationale: Audit discovered 10+ renderer files importing fs/path/child_process/crypto/Buffer directly and 6 files using @electron/remote. PR #4001 does NOT address this. Merging #4001 on top of current state carries the coupling forward and blocks Phase-B contextIsolation.
Phase-A1-5.step-1: Move `src/renderer/node/ripgrepSearcher.js` and `src/renderer/node/fileSearcher.js` to new main-process module `src/main/search/`; expose via new IPC handlers `mt::search-run`, `mt::search-cancel`. Renderer calls become `ipcRenderer.invoke()`.
Phase-A1-5.step-2: Move `src/renderer/util/fileSystem.js` contents (fs-extra writes, crypto hashes, child_process.exec for picgo/cliScript uploaders) to new main-process module `src/main/imageUpload/`; expose via `mt::image-upload`, `mt::image-hash`.
Phase-A1-5.step-4: Replace `require('fontmanager-redux')` in `src/renderer/prefComponents/common/fontTextBox/index.vue` with `ipcRenderer.invoke('mt::fonts-list')` backed by new main handler using same native module from main.
Phase-A1-5.step-6: Replace @electron/remote usage: `clipboard.read/write` → new `mt::clipboard-*` IPC; `getCurrentWindow().{minimize,maximize,close,fullscreen}` → new `mt::window-*` IPC; `new RemoteMenu/RemoteMenuItem` → new `mt::context-menu-show` IPC with serialized spec.
Phase-A1-5.step-7: Remove `@electron/remote` dependency from package.json after all 6 call-sites migrated.
Phase-A1-5.step-8: Introduce listener-cleanup convention: wrap `ipcRenderer.on` in a small helper that registers removal in Vuex module `beforeDestroy`/Pinia store `$dispose`. Fix all 59 current listeners.
Phase-A1-5.step-9: Add IME composition lock in `src/muya/lib/contentState/` — new `isComposing` flag toggled by `compositionstart`/`compositionend` listeners; all 6 keystroke handlers (enterCtrl, backspaceCtrl, tabCtrl, arrowCtrl, deleteCtrl, inputCtrl) early-return when `isComposing === true`. Queue keystrokes to apply at compositionend if safe. **This fixes R-27 CJK data loss.**
Phase-A1-5.step-10: Run full `yarn test:specs && yarn unit && yarn e2e`. Add new e2e test: `test/e2e/ime-composition.spec.js` simulating Chinese composition via CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent + InputMethodEvent. Verify Gate-Phase-A1.5 evidence.

Phase-A5.name: v1.0.1 polish: titlebar sidebar toggle + auto-resize + preferences typography
Phase-A5.goal: First post-v1.0 polish release. Three discrete UX improvements driven by user feedback after v1.0.0 brew install. No new modules, all changes within existing renderer + main process surfaces.
Phase-A5.rationale: v1.0.0 surfaced three usability frictions: (a) no quick way to hide sidebar without a keyboard shortcut or menu dive — Claude/ChatGPT-style titlebar toggle is the expected pattern; (b) sidebar toggle changes the visible editor width but window stays the same — content jumps left/right unpredictably; (c) Preferences sidebar `.item` font (18px in a 280px column with 28px icon) reads as too heavy relative to the new 22px page-title hierarchy.
Phase-A5.step-A5-1: Add a "panel-left" SVG icon button to `src/renderer/src/components/titleBar/index.vue` `.left-toolbar` (next to the existing menu button). Click dispatches the existing layout-store action `TOGGLE_LAYOUT_ENTRY` with `type='showSideBar'`. Style: 24x24, hover, `class="title-no-drag"`. Active state highlights when sidebar is visible.
Phase-A5.step-A5-2: Add new IPC `mt::request-window-content-size` (renderer → main → `BrowserWindow.setContentSize`). Wire from layout store: on sidebar toggle, request width = `EDITOR_IDEAL_WIDTH (800px) + (showSideBar ? sideBarWidth : 0) + chromePadding`. On file open also request to ideal width. Add preference `autoSnapWindowWidth` (default true) to allow opt-out. Height untouched.
Phase-A5.step-A5-3: Tighten Preferences typography: - `prefComponents/sideBar/index.vue` `.item`: font-size 18px → 15px; height 50px → 42px; icon 28x28 → 22x22. - `prefComponents/common/compound/index.vue` `h6.title`: font-size 1.1em → 1.2em (15.4px → 16.8px). Resulting hierarchy: page h4 22 > sidebar h3 20 > section h6 16.8 > sidebar item 15 > form labels 14.
Phase-A5.step-A5-4: CHANGELOG.md v1.0.1 entry; bump package.json + package-lock to 1.0.1; commit; tag v1.0.1; push to fork; CI builds; download arm64 dmg + zip; refresh Casks/mark.rb sha256 + version; push tap; user runs `brew upgrade --cask mark`.

Phase-A6.name: v1.1.0 multi-root workspace
Phase-A6.goal: Sidebar supports multiple opened folders simultaneously. Click 📂 with projects loaded ADDS another root rather than replacing. Each root has a ✕ close-button (no new menu items). Tree renders v-for over array; search ranges across all roots; nested-root rejected with notification. Persistence (lastOpenedFolders[]) deferred to v1.2.
Phase-A6.rationale: v1.1.0 sidebar redesign moved Files/TOC/Settings icons to titlebar. Once 📂 became a top-level affordance, the natural next step was multi-folder UX (like VSCode workspace). Single-root storage in ProjectStore + main-side _openedRootDirectory limits the design; refactoring to array unlocks the new UX without expanding the menu surface.
Phase-A6.step-A6-1: ProjectStore refactor: state.projectTree → state.projectTrees[]. New ADD_PROJECT(canonical-path) with dedup + nested-rejection + notification. New CLOSE_PROJECT(rootPath) emits mt::close-project-root IPC. _processTreeEvent uses longest-prefix path-segment match (NOT raw startsWith). pendingTreeEvents bucketed per-root.
Phase-A6.step-A6-2: treeCtrl invariants under multi-root: addFile/unlinkFile/addDirectory/unlinkDirectory unchanged signature, but defensive containment guard added (BLOCK_REJECT_OUT_OF_TREE) in case dispatcher routes wrong tree.
Phase-A6.step-A6-3: tree.vue: remove v-if="projectTree" single-root branch; add v-for="root in projectTrees" with :key="root.pathname". Each root section header gets a ✕ close-button (small accent button, focusable, calls projectStore.CLOSE_PROJECT). Empty-state shows when projectTrees.length===0. INTERACTIVE CHECKPOINT here — manual smoke before proceeding.
Phase-A6.step-A6-4: store/search.js runSearch(): pass array of pathnames to ripgrepDirectorySearcher.search([...]). Empty-roots short-circuit. Cancel logic preserved.
Phase-A6.step-A6-5: titleBar/index.vue handleNavClick smart logic: 📂 with sidebar open AND on Files view AND ≥1 project → opens Finder (add-another); no projects → opens Finder (first-folder); other paths → switch view, no dialog. Add log markers per V-A6-5.
Phase-A6.step-A6-6: main/windows/editor.js: _openedRootDirectory: string → _openedRootDirectories: Set<string>. New openFolder(pathname, {mode='add'|'replace'}) and closeFolder(pathname). Refuse nested-inside-existing (and reverse-nested) with realpath comparison. Idempotent re-add. Watcher respawn on death.
Phase-A6.step-A6-7: main/app/windowManager.js: new ipcMain.on('mt::close-project-root') handler — resolves window via fromWebContents, calls editor.closeFolder, idempotent + dead-window guard. Verify watcher-watch-directory and watcher-unwatch-directory remain single-path scope (NOT unwatchByWindowId).
Phase-A6.step-A6-8: i18n strings: close-folder tooltip + nested-root notification across 10 locales. Regen *.min.json.
Phase-A6.step-A6-9: Build + WT-1 (open two roots, search, close one) + WT-2 (nested-root refusal) interactive smoke. THEN tag v1.1.0 + CI + cask refresh + brew upgrade verify.

ExecutionPolicy.default-profile: mixed: Phase-0, A1, A2 autonomous (grace-multiagent-execute); A3, A4, B1-B4 interactive (grace-execute).
ExecutionPolicy.worker-owns: Only module source files (src/**, src-tauri/**, homebrew-tap/**) and module-local tests inside the approved write scope for each packet.

parallel-safe-waves.wave-A1-parallel: #4154 + #4135 + #3621 (non-overlapping file scopes) can merge in parallel; others serialize.
parallel-safe-waves.wave-B2-parallel: M-010 first, then M-002/M-003/M-004 parallel once M-010 ships.
parallel-safe-waves.wave-B3-parallel: M-005, M-006, M-008 parallel after Phase-B2; M-007 and M-009 depend on M-005 so they serialize.

escalation-triggers.trigger-1: Any red test on full spec/unit run.
escalation-triggers.trigger-2: Cherry-pick requires semantic conflict resolution (not just import-path rename).
escalation-triggers.trigger-3: Any native-module version change in package.json.
escalation-triggers.trigger-5: Any change to src/muya/ beyond explicit bugfix PRs.
escalation-triggers.trigger-6: Phase-A1.5: ANY change outside the agreed renderer-node-cleanup scope (escalate the diff diff for user review before commit).
escalation-triggers.trigger-7: @electron/remote removal side-effect: if any feature regresses during step-6 of Phase-A1.5, revert and escalate.
escalation-triggers.trigger-8: muya API snapshot mismatch: if V-M-012 API snapshot test diverges (47 methods + 26 events), escalate.

ExecutionPolicy.commit-policy: One PR-merge = one commit. No squash before v1.0 tag so blame and revert stay precise.
